aj_sales: Hey @product — big prospect (GlobalBank) pushing for a custom ratecard exception. They want a 30% per-token discount on generative inference only, embeddings billed at list, plus rollover of unused committed credits up to 2x, and overage alerts at 70%/90%. Can we do this as a standard offer or is this a special one-off?
maya_product: Thanks, aj. A few quick clarifying qs: hosted or dedicated? which models exactly count as 'generative inference'? and who owns billing/legal?
lena_support: Also flagging security — they mentioned PCI-adjacent systems. Will need clarity on data retention & logging for Private vs Hosted.
aj_sales: Hosted API. They'll commit to $200k/mo for 12mo (reserved credits) + 500k burst tokens. They want the 30% only applied to calls routed to model family `generation-v2*`. Wants a self-serve cap so their internal teams can't exceed spend without approval.
sanjay_finance: Rollover credits + per-service discounts = revenue recognition murk. Rollover up to 2x is doable but we need the GL mapping and ARR impact modeled before committing.
tom_eng: Tech note: we can tag requests by model name and emit billing_event.model_name, but we don't currently treat model_name as a billing dimension for discounts. Work required in billing pipeline.
rebecca_solutions: They also asked for a daily billing CSV with per-route + model breakdown. We have per-token export today — adding `model_name` column shouldn't be hard if eng emits it.
maya_product: Two paths: 1) Sales carveout/manual process (manual invoice adjustments + daily CSV) — quick, low-risk. 2) Product work to support first-class per-model discounts, credit rollover logic, and caps in UI — larger scope (~several sprints). Need to weigh.
aj_sales: They need a yes/no by EOW to close this quarter. If we do manual carveout now, can we commit to automating in 2 quarters?
sanjay_finance: Manual carveout acceptable short-term. We require provisional approval for discount bands and margin guardrails, review at 6 months.
tom_eng: Interim technical plan: * emit model_name on billing events (2 wks), * enrich export with model_name + route (2 wks), * offer a daily signed CSV to sales ops. Product work to implement discounting + rollover: schema updates + pipeline changes + UI — estimate ~18-20 weeks.
rebecca_solutions: For saleability, propose SOW: manual 30% discount applied via off-platform invoice for first 6 months, daily CSV, weekly reconciliation calls. Charge a manual ops premium.
maya_product: I'll draft a mini-PRD. Acceptance criteria (pre-release or manual): 1) Export shows accurate discount-eligible usage (model_name filter) 2) Rollover calculation documented and visible on invoice (even if applied manually) 3) Alerts: 70%/90% usage webhooks + console banner. For product path, also require automated per-model discounting and UI caps.
aj_sales: Can you include a sample CSV format we can share with the customer? small snippet helps close.
billing-bot: Sample export schema: ```
date,account_id,api_key,route,model_name,usage_tokens,eligible_discount_percent,charge_usd
2026-02-10,acct_123,sk-***,generate,/generation-v2-turbo,120000,30,84.00
```
maya_product: Thanks @billing-bot. Next steps: I'll capture options in a short doc + recommended path (manual now, productizing if they commit to >12mo or more customers ask). @sanjay please confirm provisional pricing band. @tom please sanity-check eng estimate.
sanjay_finance: Provisional: approve 30% for generation family for 6 months, conditional on margin threshold and signed SOW.
tom_eng: Estimate confirmed as rough numbers. If Sales wants faster automation, need prioritized ticket in product backlog.
rebecca_solutions: I'll prepare SOW template and outline manual ops runbook.
aj_sales: I'll schedule a 15m call with GlobalBank and share the CSV snippet. Thanks all :pray:
